description: This file contains helper functions for form handling in SuiteCRM, including validation, population of beans from POST data, generating hidden HTML form fields, redirect logic, and specific functions for managing prospect lists and report relationships.

methods.name: checkRequired
methods.description: Checks if specified POST values with a given prefix are set and not empty, primarily for form validation.

methods.name: populateFromPost
methods.description: Populates a given SugarBean object with data from $_POST, handling related fields, ACL restrictions, and field-specific save logic.

methods.name: add_hidden_elements
methods.description: Generates HTML hidden input elements for given key-value pairs, supporting array values.

methods.name: getPostToForm
methods.description: Produces hidden HTML form elements from $_POST data, optionally ignoring fields matching a regex.

methods.name: getGetToForm
methods.description: Produces hidden HTML form elements from $_GET data, with optional control over fields and precedence over $_POST.

methods.name: getAnyToForm
methods.description: Combines data from $_POST and $_GET into hidden form elements.

methods.name: handleRedirect
methods.description: Redirects the browser to a return URL, index.php with constructed parameters, or a custom URL.

methods.name: buildRedirectURL
methods.description: Constructs a redirect URL for index.php based on request parameters, handling different return actions and duplicate cases.

methods.name: getLikeForEachWord
methods.description: Builds a LIKE query string for each large enough word in a given input string.

methods.name: isCloseAndCreateNewPressed
methods.description: Checks if a form submission indicates 'Save and Create New' action.

methods.name: add_prospects_to_prospect_list
methods.description: Links prospect IDs to a prospect list via relationships.

methods.name: add_to_prospect_list
methods.description: Adds prospect objects from a report to a prospect list, handling relationships and access control.

methods.name: save_from_report
methods.description: Links report results (rows) to a parent bean through specified relationships.
